show.description: When Varun pretends to lose his memory after a near-fatal accident, his longtime girlfriend Kiara coldly hands him off to her step-sister, claiming she was never his lover. As Varun uncovers a web of betrayal, financial crime, and a fabricated pregnancy, he finds himself torn between a woman who used him for power and another woman (Kiara's friend) who loved him silently for years, turning a cruel amnesia prank into a devastating game of love, lies, and emotional replacement.
